integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the locating-dominating definition. The accompanying finite verifier is a stress test and not a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete bipartite graphs and does not classify every maximizing LDC-partition or arbitrary complete multipartite graphs. Originality searches reduce but cannot eliminate risk from unindexed terminology variants.
title: Locating-dominating coalition number of complete bipartite graphs
